F1: SelectedCalendar.updatedAt` is `@updatedAt`, but Prisma only stamps it when the update has other fields, and `updateMany` with empty data writes nothing, so the timestamp the comment promises never moves.
F2: Delegated connections come back with in-memory credential id `-1` (`delegationCredential/server.ts:86`), while the cache is stored under the saved credential id, so `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` never finds their cache and the status and delete controls stay hidden.
F3: deleteCacheMutation` refreshes only through the optional `onSuccess`, `EventAdvancedTab` gives the wrapper no `onChanged`, and the query has `refetchOnWindowFocus: false`, so the old timestamp and delete action stay on screen after a successful delete.
